result.brief: 提出 log-cosh 有界预测正则损失，作为即插即用训练目标改进 JEPA 类潜空间世界模型的表征质量与规划代价对齐。
result.reason: Proposes log-cosh bounded predictive loss for latent world models (V-JEPA 2.1, LeWorldModel), improving learned representations and planning alignment; a representation/training contribution for video world models.
